title: Expected-denial quantity on a straight-tip catheter liability notice: Continence Original Medicare Program
content:
On the Continence Original Medicare Program of the Urology and Continence Supply Program, a liability notice for straight-tip intermittent catheters (A4351) covers the quantity per 30 days that Medicare is expected to deny. The straight-tip allowance is 200 units per 30 days. Closed-system catheter kits (A4353) count against the same monthly limit, because the payer counts both against it.

## Rule

The expected-denial quantity per 30 days depends on the program's closed-system kit shipments:

| Kit shipments on the program | Expected-denial quantity per 30 days |
|---|---|
| within the last 3 calendar months | replaced by the newest written order's quantity, plus the newest kit order's quantity per 30 days, less the allowance of 200 |
| within the last 12 calendar months, but none within the last 3 | replaced by the newest written order's quantity, plus one twelfth of the kit units shipped in those 12 months rounded down, less the allowance of 200 |
| none within the last 12 calendar months | stays the newest written order's quantity less the allowance of 200 |

None of these is below zero.

The newest written order is the straight-tip order with the latest order date. The newest kit order is the closed-system kit (A4353) order with the latest order date. A kit shipment is within the last 3 calendar months when it is dated fewer than 3 whole calendar months before the signing date. The 12-month window is read the same way.

## Worked figures (hypothetical; newest straight-tip order 230 per 30 days)

- A kit shipped 6 weeks ago and a newest kit order of 25 per 30 days: 230 plus 25 less 200, which is 55.
- No kit in the last 3 months and 100 kit units in the last 12 months: one twelfth of 100 is 8.33, rounded down to 8, so 230 plus 8 less 200, which is 38.
- No kits in the last 12 months: 230 less 200, which is 30.
- An order of 180 with no kits gives 180 less 200, which is below zero, so the quantity is 0.
